headline.en: Go Down, Moses: hear the whole song first, then the tune on its own.

detail.en: The whole song, every part together
The guide sings it, line by line
Stop if anything tightens or hurts

headline.en: Now the tune on its own.

detail.en: Follow the words as it plays

text.en: Find the notes of line 1: each one waits until you're on it.
The Fisk Jubilee Singers' book of 1872 gives Go Down, Moses twenty-four verses, from Israel in Egypt to the Red Sea and on to freedom.

source.en: Theodore F. Seward, Jubilee Songs: As Sung by the Jubilee Singers of Fisk University (New York: Biglow & Main, 1872), pp. 22 to 23, read from the scan

text.en: Hear line 1, then sing it back.
Hear line 2, then sing it back.
Line 3 is the tune of line 1 again, with new words. Sing it with the guide.
Now lines 1 to 3 joined, with the guide.
Hear line 4, then sing it back.
Hear line 5, then sing it back.
Now lines 4 and 5 joined: hear them, then sing them back.
Hear line 6, then sing it back.
Hear line 7, then sing it back.
Now lines 6 and 7 joined: hear them, then sing them back.
Hear line 8, then sing it back.
Line 9 is the tune of line 1 again, with new words. Sing it with the guide.
Line 10 is the tune of line 2 again, with new words. Sing it with the guide.
Line 11 is the tune of line 1 again, with new words. Sing it with the guide.
Now lines 8 to 11 joined, with the guide.
Line 12 is line 4 again. Sing it with the guide.
Line 13 is line 5 again. Sing it with the guide.
Line 14 is line 6 again. Sing it with the guide.
Now lines 12 to 14 joined: hear them, then sing them back.
Line 15 is line 7 again. Sing it with the guide.
Hear line 16, then sing it back.
Now lines 15 and 16 joined: hear them, then sing them back.
Verse 1 start to end, with the guide.
Refrain start to end, with the guide.
Verse 2 start to end, with the guide.
Refrain start to end, with the guide.
The whole song, with the guide.
Sing your part with the other parts, and the guide with you. Hold your line while the others move.
The guide drops out: your part with the others only. Give me my note plays your first note quietly.
Once more on your own, from the top.
Record the tune of Go Down, Moses in Sing, with the other parts playing.
In that first printing only the answer, "Let my people go", is written in four-part harmony; every call is printed as the tune alone.
